## Summary

What does this change, and why?

## Approach

Describe the implementation and any important trade-offs.

## Risks

Describe known risks, compatibility concerns, or database changes. Write `None` when none apply.

## Review notes

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation were added or updated.
- [ ] Architecture and bounded-context boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] Database changes use a new Flyway migration and preserve existing migration history.
- [ ] No credentials, local configuration, generated output, or temporary files are included.

GitHub Actions provides the authoritative automated verification result for the current commit.
